1stgenrex: Casimir Stgenrex arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in T-S8 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Casimir Stgenrex kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. A letter from home found Casimir Stgenrex before the night shift. Casimir Stgenrex folded it small and kept it close.
commanderchris__: The new runner gave his name as Otto Commanderchr. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Otto Commanderchr and Anselm "Parson" Rock divided a parcel using the lid of a tin as scales. The final crumb required a second opinion. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Otto Commanderchr shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Otto Commanderchr tipped water from a boot and a small beetle climbed out. At least one passenger had enjoyed the crossing.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Otto Commanderchr. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him.

the Parson the crow follows Otto Commanderchr along the trench now. When the Parson flies off, men duck. They are usually right to. After the loss of Hill 304, Otto Commanderchr helped stack spare sandbags at S-F7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Somebody in S-F7 wanted to shoot the Parson for the pot. Otto Commanderchr stood in front of the rifle. The matter has been dropped.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F7 and grazed Otto Commanderchr's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Casimir Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2).
Otto Commanderchr is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Otto Commanderchr and Cyril "Mud" Sann share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F7. Otto Commanderchr has learned to walk bent double.
fidel_del_toro: Casimir Toro stepped off the supply cart at S-F12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Casimir Toro answered the first call, number 30 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached S-F12 with the rations. Casimir Toro ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Casimir Toro. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
Casimir Toro of the Hegemony and Bram Tephydraws of the Concord watched a broken branch near Verdel Ridge all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.

Casimir Toro bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Casimir Toro helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Dawn watch. Casimir Toro put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Albin Zgz, grazed.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of S-F12. When Casimir Toro challenged it, there was nobody there.
Casimir Toro practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
A local carter understood Casimir Toro's request for bread, then explained that the same sentence sounded very much like a request for a beard.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F12. Casimir Toro was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Bastian Lynxxactual of the Concord (@lynxxactual).

The House of Toro sent Nils Toro after Casimir Toro. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Nils Toro was number 30. He still remembers how stiff the colonel's glove felt.
j_u_s10: Karel Jus left a younger sister who sends drawings behind in Rosenau and came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox. The men noticed at once that he tells terrible jokes.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel Jus kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
joe_mcm09: Day 9: Pavel Mcm reached R-C12 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Pavel Mcm wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
just_sharky24: The new rifleman gave his name as Norbert Sharky. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Norbert Sharky shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Norbert Sharky. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him.
A bullet clipped Norbert Sharky's helmet at R-F6 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Clement Snake of the Hegemony (@jake_the_snake6424).

Norbert Sharky no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home found Norbert Sharky before the night shift. Norbert Sharky folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Norbert Sharky watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

the Parson the crow follows Norbert Sharky along the trench now. When the Parson flies off, men duck. They are usually right to. A letter from home found Norbert Sharky before the night shift. Norbert Sharky folded it small and kept it close.
A man asked Norbert Sharky to describe Marrow Fen without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.

A round went through the rim of Norbert Sharky's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck). Norbert Sharky fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp was grazed. A letter from home found Norbert Sharky before the night shift. Norbert Sharky folded it small and kept it close.

Norbert Sharky was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F6. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck). Norbert Sharky was killed on watch at R-F6. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck).
Wendel Sharky came to the front because his cousin Norbert Sharky never came home. He carries his mother's thimble.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Wendel Sharky was hit hard in the fight at R-F6 before anyone could fire. The raider was Konrad Cbour of the Hegemony. Raider: Konrad Cbour of the Hegemony (@cbour57_). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Wendel Sharky kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
kapitancray: Nils Kapitancray reported to R-C8 with his brother's pocket watch sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Nils Kapitancray during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
m.w_1254: Zeno "Shadow" Mw came up on Day 9 carrying news from Brennmoor. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Zeno "Shadow" Mw fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Roland Rudransh was grazed. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Zeno "Shadow" Mw watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
mg42svt40m1919type99k98k: Oskar "Rabbit" Type came from Oakmere, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Oskar "Rabbit" Type watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
mouthfullofrocks: On Day 9 Albin Mouthfullofr took a post at S-R5 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He shares cigarettes but never smokes, and the men liked him for it.

Albin Mouthfullofr was hit in the forearm at S-R5. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple). On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Albin Mouthfullofr wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
nico.theanimator: They issued Yann Theanimator a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a bullet that missed him in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Yann Theanimator jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Valentin Thky. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@haydnburrell_9thky) Yann Theanimator jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Zeno "Mud" Jwger. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@jwger87) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Yann Theanimator watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
patatas_ogkratas: Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas walked into R-S2 on Day 8 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas and Albin "Spark" Bananarail carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Norbert "Crow" Ogkratas wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
saruulraj: Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj came from Kesselby, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Wendel "Owl" Saruulraj looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
tuckerdesaveur: After 9 days of war, S-R1 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
tyler.zenga: Marek Zenga came up on Day 9 carrying news from Stoneyford. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Marek Zenga fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Walter "Crow" Viti was grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Marek Zenga stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
w0lfer2210: Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer was a blacksmith in Millbank until the posters went up. He came to S-F3 with a rosary of rough beads, and within a day the whole squad knew that he reads the same book over and over.

Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

Wiring party. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F3, and everyone came back. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Jakub "Shadow" Camper, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Bram Tephydraws crossed it, Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer fired. Bram Tephydraws was grazed. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Ivo Boi, badly wounded. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

The water jacket hissed as Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Jakub "Shadow" Camper was badly wounded. Brass cases piled up around Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer's boots at S-F3. Out of all those rounds, one found Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy, grazed. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-F3 changed before the cheering ended. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer shouldered another load. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.
